title: Remote software deployment fails
symptom: A software update pushed by the deployment tool failed on some PCs
user_description: The new PDF reader rolled out to 80 PCs last night, but the console shows 12 failed. Can you find out why and get them done?

options.text: Share the admin password so users can install it themselves
options.why: Admin passwords must never be shared with users.

options.text: Give the users admin rights for a day
options.why: A big security risk to solve a deployment problem.
Leaves 12 PCs without the update and hides the problem.

options.text: Read the deployment log for those PCs, check they are online, have disk space, meet the requirements and are in the right target group, then retry
options.why: The log shows why each one failed. Offline PCs, full disks, missing requirements or the wrong group are the usual reasons.

hints: What does the deployment tool record about each failure?
Were those PCs even switched on?
Do they meet what the software needs?
real_world_tip: Group the failures by error code. Often most of them share one simple cause, like being offline overnight.
